gloss_en: Why do Open IFC and Link IFC in Revit give very different results?
question_paraphrase: asks for official feedback on why File>Open IFC makes in-place families without IFC data while Link IFC gives different geometry and duplicates assemblies
phrasing_notes: polite, 'appreciate some official feedback', compares two methods
answer_summary: Open and Link are separate code paths (old C++ vs newer C# API); roadmap is to unify on Link IFC.

gloss_en: Linking IFC into Revit does not turn IfcSpace into Rooms/Spaces
title_original: Link IFC does not create Room/Space from IfcSpace
question_paraphrase: wants IfcSpace to become Rooms (architect model) or Spaces (MEP) when linking; Open IFC does it but is worse otherwise
answer_summary: Link IFC brings IfcSpace as generic models; Open IFC converts to Rooms; maintainers asked how to decide Room vs Space.

gloss_en: Can Comments and Mark parameters exported to IFC be imported back into Revit?
question_paraphrase: asks if Pset values like Comments/Mark exported from Revit come back on import
answer_summary: Link IFC shows them; Open IFC historically blocks setting built-in parameters.

gloss_en: How do I turn a 30-storey IFC into 2D SVG floor plans with IfcConvert?
title_original: Convert IFC file into svg floor plans
question_paraphrase: dragged IFC on the converter exe and only got an .obj; how to choose SVG output
answer_summary: Use command-line options of IfcConvert to select output format/section.

gloss_en: How to rotate one object in an IFC by editing the file with IfcOpenShell?
title_original: How to rotate a specific object of IFC model?
question_paraphrase: translating by editing Location is easy but rotation is not; wants simple way
answer_summary: Edit the placement axis/ref direction or use the api placement functions.

gloss_en: Door types from Revit IFC share one property set so IsExternal cannot be edited per type
title_original: It is not possible to change IsExternal Properties of separate types independently in IFC exported from Revit
question_paraphrase: editing IsExternal on one door type changes the other because the Pset is shared
answer_summary: Revit exporter shares psets across types by design to save space.

gloss_en: A small MEP IFC opens in BC ZOOM but not in Bonsai or BIMvision
title_original: Basic (MEP) IFC file cannot be opened
question_paraphrase: file would not open in several viewers; only BC ZOOM and Xbim Xplorer showed it
context_given: file made for downgrade migration test
answer_summary: Open bug on loader; file quality/parsing issue.

gloss_en: Tell me what is in this IFC file
prompt: just got this ifc from my architect. what is even in it? like how many floors and what kind of stuff
expected_behavior: Report IFC schema version, project name, storeys, count of elements by class, in plain language.

gloss_en: List storeys with elevations
prompt: how many levels does this have and at what heights
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey names and elevations in project units.

gloss_en: Free way to view IFC without Revit
prompt: I dont have revit, whats the easiest free way to look at this ifc? no install if possible
expected_behavior: Suggest browser-based or free viewers, note limits; if a model is loaded offer a summary instead.

gloss_en: Total wall area
prompt: whats the total wall area in here, ext walls only
expected_behavior: Filter IfcWall with IsExternal true, sum NetSideArea/GrossSideArea from Qto_WallBaseQuantities, state which quantity used.

gloss_en: Why is everything proxy
prompt: why are so many things IfcBuildingElementProxy?? this came out of revit
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by ObjectType/category, suggest export mapping fixes.

gloss_en: IFC vs DWG vs RVT in simple words
prompt: ifc vs rvt vs dwg - which one do i send to the contractor and why
expected_behavior: Explain open exchange (IFC) vs native Revit vs CAD drawings; recommend per purpose.

gloss_en: Fire rating of doors
prompt: which doors have fire rating and what are they
expected_behavior: Read Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating for IfcDoor, list by value and missing.

gloss_en: Can I edit IFC in Revit
prompt: can i actually edit this ifc in revit or is it just a reference? tried open and link, different results
expected_behavior: Explain Link vs Open, in-place families, loss of parametrics; edits belong in the source model.

gloss_en: Room areas list
prompt: need list of rooms with area and level for the FM sheet
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace name, number, level, net floor area; flag missing areas.

gloss_en: Rename a property set
prompt: change the Pset name on all walls from Pset_X to Pset_Wall_Custom and save as new file
expected_behavior: Rename pset on IfcWall instances, save a copy, report count changed.

gloss_en: File opens empty
prompt: opened the ifc and its blank/white?? file is 40mb
expected_behavior: Check for geometry representations, units, far-away coordinates; report findings.

gloss_en: Is model far from origin
prompt: model looks tiny in viewer, is it located miles away from origin?
expected_behavior: Compute bounding box and placement offsets, report distance from origin and units.

gloss_en: Concrete volume
prompt: give me total concrete volume of slabs and columns
expected_behavior: Sum NetVolume for IfcSlab/IfcColumn with concrete material, state source and gaps.

gloss_en: What changed between two files
prompt: here are v1 and v2 of the model, what changed
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId: added, removed, modified elements by class.

gloss_en: Is this a valid IFC

expected_behavior: Parse and validate schema conformance, list errors, state IFC version.

gloss_en: Does it contain data or just 3D
prompt: does this file have real data like materials and costs or is it just a 3d shape
expected_behavior: Check for property sets, materials, classifications, cost items versus geometry-only elements.
